trend_90_day.description: TVL doubled from ~$1B in early 2025 to $2.5B by Feb 2026. Sharp growth driven by Solana expansion and tokenized equities launch.

total_value_locked.notes: TVL figures aggregated from DefiLlama and Ondo announcements. Exact real-time breakdown across all chains requires live API query.

major_unlock.description: 57% of total supply became tradable in January 2026 unlock event

ousg.supply_model: elastic — minted/burned on demand against USDC deposits
ousg.notes: NAV per token from Etherscan snapshot (Nov 2025). Supply grows with deposits; no fixed cap.

usdy.supply_model: elastic — minted on deposit, burned on redemption
usdy.notes: Price appreciates as yield accrues. Also available as rUSDY (rebasing, pegged to $1.00).

ousg_ethereum.notes: Low holder count reflects KYC-gated institutional product (Qualified Purchasers / Accredited Investors only)

usdy_ethereum.notes: USDY has broader non-US retail access; likely higher holder count than OUSG

ondo_token_ethereum.notes: Governance token with wide exchange listings; significantly higher holder count expected

unique_holders.cross_chain_total: Unverified — requires aggregation across Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, Mantle, Sui, Aptos, etc.

transaction_volume.ousg_daily_volume: Unverified — primarily OTC / instant manager mints and redemptions, not exchange-traded
transaction_volume.monthly_volume: Unverified — requires off-chain disclosure or DefiLlama API aggregation
transaction_volume.notes: OUSG trades mainly through Ondo's instant manager (mint/redeem), not on DEXes. ONDO governance token has high derivatives/perps volume.

usdy_dex.depth: Moderate liquidity challenges noted; scaling via multi-chain deployment

ousg_dex.availability: Not actively traded on DEXes; minting/redemption via OUSGInstantManager contract
ousg_dex.notes: Institutional product — liquidity provided through protocol's instant mint/redeem mechanism

liquidity_pools.notes: Liquidity gaps remain a challenge as Ondo scales. Bridge via LayerZero OFT standard across chains.

protocol_revenue.actual_revenue_collected: Near-zero — fees waived for growth phase
protocol_revenue.monetization_timeline: H2 2026 — Ondo preparing to begin fee collection
protocol_revenue.fee_sharing: Recently introduced fee-sharing program for ONDO token holders
protocol_revenue.notes: Currently in growth-first mode. No direct revenue redistribution to token holders yet. DAO treasury funded from operational revenues.

known_info.sweep_fund_seed: $200M seed capital (State Street + Galaxy Asset Management partnership)
known_info.dao_treasury: DAO treasury exists but balance not publicly disclosed on-chain

asset_type.ousg: Short-term US Government Treasuries, GSE securities, bank deposits, USDC (for liquidity)
asset_type.usdy: Short-term US Treasuries, iShares Short Treasury Bond ETF shares, bank demand deposits

asset_backing.asset_description: OUSG portfolio primarily holds BlackRock BUIDL fund, with allocations to Franklin Templeton, WisdomTree, Fidelity, and Wellington/FundBridge vehicles. USDY is backed by US Treasuries and bank deposits, offering ~3.69% APY.

custodian_trustee.ousg_fund_custodian: Coinbase (USDC-to-USD conversion); underlying assets held by BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, WisdomTree
custodian_trustee.ondo_global_markets: US-registered custodial broker-dealers (SPV: Ondo Global Markets BVI Limited)
custodian_trustee.21shares_trust_custodian: Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC (SOC 1 Type 2 & SOC 2 Type 2 attestations)

proof_of_reserves.mechanism: Multi-layered: daily third-party attestations + independent fund administration + on-chain oracle pricing
proof_of_reserves.attestation_provider: Ankura Trust Company (daily attestations for Ondo Global Markets)
proof_of_reserves.fund_administrator: NAV Consulting (daily read-only access to fund accounts)
proof_of_reserves.on_chain_component: Ondo Chain validators verify off-chain data (asset prices via price feeds, proof of reserves via custodians) — enshrined in consensus
proof_of_reserves.oracle_integration: Chainlink Data Feeds as primary pricing layer for tokenized equities (live since Feb 2026)

latest_attestation.attestation_type: Daily attestations by Ankura Trust Company
latest_attestation.auditor: Ankura Trust Company (attestation); annual financial audits by independent audit firm (name not publicly disclosed)
latest_attestation.notes: Full financial audits conducted annually; results shared with authorized requesting parties. Public attestation portal available online.

ousg.daily_limit: Amount shown on website (varies by liquidity)
ousg.smart_contract: OUSGInstantManager verifies KYC via OndoIDRegistry before processing

usdy.type: Bank wire redemption (non-US accounts only) or API via Ondo Global Markets
usdy.secondary_market: Can sell on DEXes (Orca, Raydium, Uniswap) if available

usdy.description: Temporary Global Certificate issued within 2-3 business days; tokens minted after restricted period ends

disclosed_incidents.description: Vulnerability in Tranche Token / UniswapStrategy contracts that could have allowed draining ~$50M. Feature was not enabled at time of disclosure.
disclosed_incidents.remediation: Fixed same day; no user funds at risk

known_vulnerabilities.past_exploits: None — no funds have been lost to exploits

upgrade_proxy_pattern.description: All core token contracts (OUSG, rOUSG, USDY, rUSDY) use Transparent Proxy. Admin can upgrade implementation, manage KYC registry, pause/unpause, blocklist addresses. Factory contracts (e.g., rUSDYFactory) deploy new upgradeable instances.
upgrade_proxy_pattern.centralization_risk: Acknowledged by Ondo — admins have broad setter access, burn capabilities, token retrieval, and multicall functions

admin_multisig.signer_count: Unverified — requires on-chain Safe query for threshold and signer list
admin_multisig.governance_transition: Long-term shift toward DAO governance via ONDO token holders (on-chain proposals)
admin_multisig.notes: Exact multisig threshold (e.g., 3-of-5, 4-of-7) not publicly documented. Recommend querying Safe API for current signer config.

bug_bounty.reward_calculation: 10% of funds directly affected (for critical smart contract bugs)
bug_bounty.policy: Primacy of Impact — reports accepted even if affected asset is out-of-scope, as long as impact is in-scope

ousg_structure.registration: Section 3(c)(7) Investment Company Act of 1940 exemption
ousg_structure.investor_requirements: Qualified Purchasers and verified Accredited Investors

usdy_structure.entity: Ondo USDY LLC (folded into Ondo Global Markets as of 2025-12-15)
usdy_structure.registration: Money services business registered with FinCEN

ondo_global_markets.structure: Dedicated SPV, wholly separate from Ondo Finance Inc. and Ondo Foundation
ondo_global_markets.governance: Board of Directors with independent director
ondo_global_markets.asset_segregation: Full segregation of assets, accounting, and operations

sec_status.investigation: SEC closed two-year investigation in November 2025 — no charges recommended

partnerships_and_integrations.oracle: Chainlink Data Feeds (primary pricing layer since Feb 2026)

upcoming.sweep_fund: $200M seed (State Street + Galaxy Asset Management) — launching 2026
upcoming.ondo_chain: Purpose-built L1 with enshrined oracles and proof of reserves in consensus

strengths: Largest tokenized US Treasuries issuer by TVL ($2.5B+)
Extensive audit history (25+ audits from 10+ firms)
SEC investigation closed with no charges
Active $1M bug bounty program on Immunefi
risks: Smart contracts are upgradeable with centralized admin control (Gnosis Safe multisig — exact threshold unknown)
Fees currently waived — protocol generates near-zero revenue; sustainability depends on H2 2026 monetization
57% token supply unlocked Jan 2026 — significant dilution/selling pressure risk
USDY has 40-50 day lock-up period limiting instant liquidity
Liquidity depth on DEXes remains a challenge
Multisig signer composition and threshold not publicly documented
KYC-gated products limit composability within permissionless DeFi
